# gyro_backup_space_plans (Data Source)

Orderable Gyro Backup Space plans (GET /cloud/backup-spaces/plans): sizes with prices per billing cycle (fixed EUR, VAT excluded; list_amount = strike-through list price) and the servers of the account a space can be bound to. Empty plans = not orderable for this account yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Orderable sizes with EUR prices, and the servers a backup space can be bound to.
data "gyro_backup_space_plans" "all" {}

output "backup_plans" {
  value = [for p in data.gyro_backup_space_plans.all.plans : "${p.plan}: ${p.prices[0].amount} ${p.prices[0].currency}/${p.prices[0].cycle}"]
}
```

## Schema

- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))
- `servers` (Attributes List) Servers a backup space can be bound to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

Read-Only:

- `plan` (String) Plan name for gyro_backup_space.plan (50gb, 100gb, 250gb, 500gb, 1tb).
- `prices` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans--prices))
